details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, and K3 are fully present with supporting sentences. K6 is partially present as the acquisition of the Spordi Street site is mentioned, but details about apartment count, investment amount, pre-sales timing, and handover schedule are missing. All other criteria (K4, K5, K7, K8, K9, K10) are entirely absent from the candidate summary. The coverage is mixed with major high-importance items missing, placing it in the Neutral/Mixed category.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no contradictions or logical gaps. All statements build logically upon each other, showing consistent financial improvement trends from 2024 to 2025 across revenue, profit, and balance sheet metrics. The organizational flow moves naturally from revenue drivers to profitability, then to balance sheet changes and operational highlights. While there is a minor arithmetic relationship between total sales (1,706) and sum of real estate sales (1,589) plus service/franchise (117), this is not a contradiction because the candidate does not claim these are exhaustive additive components of the same total. The summary maintains clear progression without unnecessary repetition.
